claim_text: PC-CNG is a truly learned reaction-conditioned reaction-center-aware structured generator not a rule library wrapper
statistical_method: held-out source-expert validation + future paired source comparison
limitations: Phase C validates real supervision semantics and internal source-expert endpoints only. It does not compare learned vs rule/random/union and therefore does not validate the full headline claim.

claim_text: PC-CNG negatives significantly outperform 7 baselines on >=2 datasets and >=2 backbones on preregistered primary task
dataset: Current HiTEA single publication source; second real HTE planned
statistical_method: paired cluster bootstrap + hierarchical seed-cluster aggregation + paired permutation + Holm
limitations: v3 formal: PC-CNG vs random delta=+0.02835 CI=[-0.01106,0.08281] Holm p=0.7695; PC-CNG vs template delta=+0.02112 CI=[-0.01408,0.06832] Holm p=0.4417; union vs PC-CNG delta=-0.02399 CI=[-0.06768,0.00584] Holm p=0.8597. PC-CNG is non-inferior to random/template at margin 0.02 but superiority is unsupported. Only one evaluable source-publication slice, so source-macro does not establish cross-publication replication. Historical v2.1 remains audit history only.

claim_text: G6 v3 formal benchmark has reviewer-auditable task and inference semantics
primary_endpoint: formal contract + independent primary object equality
statistical_method: complete primary-inference object equality after documented legacy boolean normalization

claim_text: Reaction-conditioned adaptive source gate outperforms validation-frozen best single source and uniform union
statistical_method: paired cluster bootstrap

claim_text: Learned structured source provides unique incremental value inside the multi-source policy

limitations: Policy JS shift is 0.169 for MLP and 0.259 for GNN; family dependence and selection entropy vary by cell. This is association only; matched intervention and held-out replication are absent and mechanism_exit_met=false.

claim_text: Phase E can execute an independently custodied sealed external evaluation without development-label contamination
primary_endpoint: contract validation + forbidden-hash collision + signed label receipt

statistical_method: fail-closed schema + hash + row-identity + development-collision validation
limitations: Only metadata has been registered; no external labels were downloaded or viewed. Blind confirmatory evidence requires an independent custodian to isolate labels and return a valid receipt after model and analysis freeze.

primary_endpoint: pilot integrity + reviewer completeness + agreement/control gate
statistical_method: artifact hash audit + frozen weighted-kappa/ordinal-alpha/control analysis
limitations: 80 unique items; 10 per source/control stratum; three independently randomized blinded forms; 10 measured high-yield and 10 reported zero-yield controls. Forms and unblinded key stay outside public Git. No expert-validation claim until three real independent responses are returned.
